question: Dead Sea is bordered by which two countries?
solution:
The correct answer is __Israel and Jordan.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Dead Sea, also called Salt Sea, is a landlocked salt lake located between Israel and Jordan in southwestern Asia__.
 
• The Dead Sea receives nearly all its water from the Jordan River.
 
• The main tributary of Dead sea is Jordan River.
 
• It is situated between the hills of Judaea to the west and the Transjordanian plateaus to the east.
 
• The southwestern side of the lake is a tall Halite mineral formation called Mount Sodom.
